cohort.name: observed_root_text
cohort.rule: all requests in observed-root parent components containing only type=text

methods.history: strictly earlier cohort inputs; 0 < age <= window; unlimited has no age cap
methods.time_arithmetic: Decimal(str(source timestamp)) subtraction for window boundaries and reported ages; original legacy fields retain historical float arithmetic
methods.fraction_denominator: original input token count, including partial-block tokens
methods.scopes: all / within same observed parent component / another component; maxima not additive
methods.high_low_groups: current unlimited-history overlap >=0.5 versus <0.5; disjoint requests
methods.chain_incidence: event chains / chains with any request in the same group and stratum; groups can share chains
methods.strata: time, prompt length, turn, and joint; context/history remain full-cohort
methods.significance: none; dependencies and confounding prevent independent-request interpretation
methods.completion_cache_and_latency: unobserved; no inference or cache simulation
methods.standardization: Descriptive high-minus-low contrast weighted to the combined request distribution of joint time/length/turn strata with >=30 requests per group. Coverage is explicit; coarse adjustment cannot eliminate confounding.

sampling.limitation: The first shard is a convenience frame. This is not a corpus-wide probability sample; unknown duplicates outside the 200 rows remain possible.

reconstruction.template: pinned Qwen3, enable_thinking=False, add_generation_prompt=True; no invented system message; source assistant texts used only for CPU length audit

smoke.selection: first 8 eligible rows with >=2 user turns in the seeded sample order; deliberate validity selection

experiment.selection: first 64 remaining eligible rows in seeded sample order; no overlap-based or length-based ranking

replay_sets.context_screen: source transcript prompts plus a proposed 512-token output cap; generated histories can differ and require a runtime context check

limitations: No measured cache hits, TTFT, completions, replica routing or queue contention in these traces.
History-window sensitivity is not TTL or finite-memory cache performance.
Descriptive co-occurrence and coarse standardization do not establish causation or significance.
WildChat uses a one-shard convenience sampling frame; generated-response replay remains to be implemented.
